records.title: ZeroQ: A Novel Zero Shot Quantization Framework
records.reason: Retain borderline because zero-shot quantization is a potentially transferable inference-memory technique; the paper validates CNN-style vision models rather than LLMs, so a language-model reproduction is required before relevance is established.

records.title: LocalMamba: Visual State Space Model with Windowed Selective Scan
records.reason: The primary abstract focuses on visual recognition and does not evaluate language-model inference.

records.title: Scaling Local Self-Attention for Parameter Efficient Visual Backbones
records.reason: Borderline transfer candidate: local attention could inform long-context causal attention, but the source’s image-specific positional/window setup and visual-only benchmarks do not show language-model quality or serving gains.

records.title: CogACT: A Foundational Vision-Language-Action Model for Synergizing Cognition and Action in Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: Borderline only: this is a VLA application using a language module, but its contribution is model architecture/action quality and no latency, throughput, memory, or inference optimization is measured.

records.title: DoLa: Decoding by Contrasting Layers Improves Factuality in Large Language Models
records.reason: Although it modifies LLM inference, the stated goal and experiments are factuality. Appendix F reports 1.8–3.0% extra peak GPU-memory overhead; it does not improve compute, memory, latency, or throughput.
